title: ClusteredConvolutionalPerceptron.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Nonconvex feasibility in jointly trained parameters θ=((a,b),v): find θ with a⟨D_i,v⟩+b⟨S D_i,v⟩>0 for every sample, where S is the cyclic shift. The margins are bilinear in the two parameter blocks; no scalar optimization objective is specified.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query selects a sample i and arbitrary θ=((a,b),v). The oracle returns the exact margin gradient ((⟨D_i,v⟩,⟨S D_i,v⟩),aD_i+bS D_i). Replies are independent of history and oracle seed; there is no oracle error or sampling requirement.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The same oracle call also returns the exact selected-sample margin a⟨D_i,v⟩+b⟨S D_i,v⟩.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Features lie in Euclidean R^d, with d>0; parameters lie in (R×R)×R^d. There are N=samples+1≥1 samples, and S cyclically permutes feature coordinates.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Write g=lower, R=upper, μ=contrast, κ=derivativeMargin, and e=d^(-1/2)1. Hidden data admit D_i=(β_i/√2)e+μz_i with g≤|β_i|≤R, ⟨e,z_i⟩=0, and a common hidden center c satisfying ‖c‖≤1/2, ‖(c−Sc)/√2‖≥2κ, and ‖z_i−c‖≤κ/64. Background signs may differ. Public parameters satisfy 0<g≤R, μ>0, 0<κ≤1/4, and (μ/(4R))²≤κ²(g/(4R))⁸/4096. All six Params fields are public; the data and geometric witnesses are hidden. No algorithm-family restriction is imposed.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The returned parameter must have strictly positive margin on every one of the N samples simultaneously. No ε tolerance, prescribed positive margin, norm bound, or objective-gap criterion is specified.

accuracy.label: deterministic
accuracy.details: Success is required for every algorithm and oracle seed, stronger than almost-sure success. The fixed budget is N(⌈128R²/g² log(16R²/μ²)⌉₊+3) individual margin-and-gradient oracle calls.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines bilinear convolutional separation with a tightly clustered hidden defect geometry, signed background amplitudes, a cyclic-difference lower bound, and a restrictive contrast regime. These are specialized structural assumptions beyond standard separable classification.

descriptionHtml:
Clustered Convolutional Separation

We seek a convolutional separator θ=((a,b),w)∈R2×Rd for samples z0,…,zn∈Rd, where d≥1 and n≥0 are integers. Each sample combines a constant background of bounded, nonzero magnitude with an orthogonal defect; the defects cluster near a small center with a nonzero cyclic difference, subject to a quantitative small-contrast condition. Writing S for the cyclic coordinate shift, the margin is mi(θ)=a⟨zi,w⟩+b⟨Szi,w⟩. At a queried sample and parameter, the oracle returns this margin and its exact parameter derivative. The goal is an output θ¯ satisfying mi(θ¯)>0 for every sample and every realization of the algorithm’s randomness.

Equip the feature space Rd with its Euclidean inner product and norm. For coordinates indexed by j=0,…,d−1, define (Sv)j=v(j−1)modd,u=1d(1,…,1). The task is the strict feasibility problem of finding θ∈R2×Rd with positive margins on all n+1 samples. The algorithm receives d,n,g,R,μ,κ; the samples and their geometric decomposition are accessed only through the oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Parameter regime). The background bounds g,R, contrast μ, and derivative margin κ satisfy 0<g≤R,μ>0,0<κ≤14,(μ4R)2≤κ24096(g4R)8.

Assumption 2 (Clustered sample geometry). There exist background coefficients h0,…,hn∈R, defects v0,…,vn∈Rd, and a center c∈Rd such that, for every i=0,…,n, zi=hi2ν+μvi,g≤|hi|≤R,⟨ν,vi⟩=0,∥vi−c∥≤κ64. The center satisfies ∥c∥≤12,‖c−Sc2‖≥2κ.

A query consists of an index i∈{0,…,n} and any parameter θ=((a,b),w)∈R2×Rd. The exact oracle returns the scalar margin mi(θ) and the direction Gi(θ)=((⟨zi,w⟩,⟨Szi,w⟩),azi+bSzi). After the allotted oracle calls, the output θ¯∈R2×Rd must satisfy mi(θ¯)>0for every i∈{0,…,n}, for every realization of the algorithm’s randomness.

source:
import LongTails.Setups.ManySampleConvolutionalPerceptron

open OracleTemplate
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.ClusteredConvolutionalPerceptron

abbrev Features := TwoSampleQuadraticPerceptron.Features
abbrev Space := ManySampleConvolutionalPerceptron.Space
abbrev Reply := ManySampleConvolutionalPerceptron.Reply
noncomputable abbrev axis := ManySampleConvolutionalPerceptron.axis
abbrev Data (d n : ℕ) := Fin (n + 1) → Features d
abbrev Query (d n : ℕ) := Fin (n + 1) × Space d

structure Geometry {d n : ℕ} (D : Data d n) (g R μ κ : ℝ) where
  background : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ
  defect : Fin (n + 1) → Features d
  center : Features d
  sample_eq : ∀ i, D i = (background i / Real.sqrt 2) • axis d + μ • defect i
  background_lower : ∀ i, g ≤ |background i|
  background_upper : ∀ i, |background i| ≤ R
  centered : ∀ i, ⟪axis d, defect i⟫ = 0
  center_norm : ‖center‖ ≤ 1 / 2
  derivative_lower : 2 * κ ≤ ‖(Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ •
    (center - TwoSampleQuadraticPerceptron.shift center)‖
  cap : ∀ i, ‖defect i - center‖ ≤ κ / 64

noncomputable def answer {d n : ℕ} (D : Data d n) (query : Query d n) : Reply d :=
  ⟨TwoSampleQuadraticPerceptron.margin .conv d (D query.1) query.2,
    TwoSampleQuadraticPerceptron.direction .conv d (D query.1) query.2⟩

def Separates {d n : ℕ} (D : Data d n) (θ : Space d) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, 0 < TwoSampleQuadraticPerceptron.margin .conv d (D i) θ

structure Params where
  dimension : ℕ
  samples : ℕ
  lower : ℝ
  upper : ℝ
  contrast : ℝ
  derivativeMargin : ℝ

noncomputable def spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := Data p.dimension p.samples
  Query p := Query p.dimension p.samples
  Reply p := Reply p.dimension
  Output p := Space p.dimension
  publicInput := id
  valid p :=
    0 < p.dimension ∧ 0 < p.lower ∧ p.lower ≤ p.upper ∧ 0 < p.contrast ∧
      0 < p.derivativeMargin ∧ p.derivativeMargin ≤ 1 / 4 ∧
      (p.contrast / (4 * p.upper)) ^ 2 ≤
        p.derivativeMargin ^ 2 * (p.lower / (4 * p.upper)) ^ 8 / 4096
  admissible p D oracle :=
    Nonempty (Geometry D p.lower p.upper p.contrast p.derivativeMargin) ∧
    ∀ history query seed, oracle.answer history query seed = answer D query.2
  successful _ D output _ := ∀ ω, Separates D (output ω)

end LongTails.Setups.ClusteredConvolutionalPerceptron
